mainEntity.name: Is Deshaun Watson the Browns' starting quarterback right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Browns head coach Todd Monken said on September 14, 2026 that he anticipates Watson starting Week 2 against Tampa Bay after reviewing the Week 1 tape. It is a start for one game, not a season-long announcement.

mainEntity.name: When does Shedeur Sanders start for the Browns?

acceptedAnswer.text: No date has been given. ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that Cleveland's plan entering the season was to start Watson for the first two games, both on the road, and re-evaluate afterwards, which puts the first realistic window around the home opener on September 27, 2026 against the Carolina Panthers.

mainEntity.name: How did Deshaun Watson do in Week 1 against Jacksonville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Watson completed 16 of 22 passes (72.7%) for 205 yards with one touchdown and one interception, was sacked five times, and posted a 97.7 passer rating. He also led the Browns with 38 rushing yards. Cleveland lost 34-10 and trailed 24-0 in the first half. It was his first start in 693 days.

mainEntity.name: Why not bench Deshaun Watson after one bad game?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Browns were flagged 11 times and allowed five sacks, so the loss was not only a quarterback problem. Watson is also on a five-year, $230 million fully guaranteed contract signed after the 2022 trade, which makes a clean release difficult; a post-June-1 designation is the realistic mechanism next spring.

mainEntity.name: What are Shedeur Sanders' Browns stats?

acceptedAnswer.text: In eight games and seven starts during the 2025 season, Sanders completed 56.6% of his passes for 1,400 yards with seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions, rushed for 169 yards, and finished 3-4, closing the season with three wins as a starter.

mainEntity.name: Who is the Browns' backup quarterback in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shedeur Sanders and Dillon Gabriel entered the 2026 season as the backups behind Deshaun Watson, after Sanders pushed for the starting job throughout training camp and the preseason.

mainEntity.name: When do the Browns play their home opener in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sunday, September 27, 2026 against the Carolina Panthers at Huntington Bank Field, 1:00 PM ET on FOX. It is the Browns' latest home opener since 1975, because Cleveland opens the season with road games at Jacksonville and Tampa Bay.

mainEntity.name: Are the Browns playing Baker Mayfield in Week 2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cleveland visits Raymond James Stadium on Sunday, September 20, 2026 to face the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who lost their own opener at Cincinnati.

mainEntity.name: Should I buy a Shedeur Sanders shirt now?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want something that survives the news cycle, no. Gear tied to a specific quarterback can go out of date the moment the depth chart changes. Independent fan-made designs that reference the team rather than a single player stay wearable through the decision.
